claim_text: Under H5, H2, H3, H6, and H7, Theorem 4 bounds W2 by a drift term epsilon plus a discretization term of order sqrt(h) sqrt(d^3).

family.coupling: joint standard Gaussian endpoints with Cov(X0,X1)=rho I_d

acceptance_criteria: H3, H6, and H7 are certified with explicit Gaussian constants.
H5 equals epsilon exactly for the constant drift perturbation.
Exact W2 decreases under grid refinement for every d and rho.
The endpoint mean contribution is linear in epsilon.
An independent matrix-square-root checker matches exact W2.
SymPy verifies the displayed dimension term is O(sqrt(d^3)).
